incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - private-controlplane-unreachable for customer SolsticeHealth (severity: 2). Details: control-plane API unresponsive from customer VPC in us-west-2. Triggered at 2026-03-14T06:12:01Z. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-xyz

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD-9876 created and notified: oncall (primary).

sara: acked on PD, jumping in — seeing multiple heartbeats missing from 'solstice-onprem-agent' since 06:11:45 UTC. Customer says new deploys are failing and healthchecks 502ing.

aj: oncall here, acked. Thanks @sara. Can someone paste latest agent logs and control-plane status?

kyle: pasting minimal logs: ```Mar 14 06:10:59 agent[1]: heartbeat sent to cp-10-2-44-5:443
Mar 14 06:11:44 agent[1]: connection reset by peer
Mar 14 06:11:45 agent[1]: heartbeat failed: tls handshake timeout
Mar 14 06:12:00 agent[1]: reconnecting...```

li: I can confirm from our control-plane proxy metrics we're seeing an abrupt spike in TLS handshake failures from that customer's peer IP (10.2.44.5). Looks like either route/ACL change on their side or upstream NAT/timeouts.

marta: I'm running the runbook "private-controlplane-unreachable" now: checking VPC peering, route tables, and NACLs. First step: can someone run `ip route get 10.2.44.5` from cp-host-3 and paste?

kyle: from cp-host-3: `ip route get 10.2.44.5` -> "10.2.44.5 via 10.0.0.1 dev eth1 src 10.0.0.12 uid 1000". Ping to 10.2.44.5 times out. Traceroute stops at customer edge (10.0.0.1).

sara: customer support on the thread: "we rolled out a routing change to consolidate egress last night, could that have affected the peering?" They're investigating.

ben: I'm going to open a cloud provider network case — sometimes their transit node dropped routes after config sync. I'll also flip a temporary fallback route to route via the secondary peer (10.0.0.9) as a mitigation. Doing it now.

pagerduty: Incident PD-9876 acknowledged by aj. If not resolved in 15m, escalation to (oncall-backup) will fire.

aj: quick mitigation plan: 1) Ensure fallback route via 10.0.0.9 is live (ben). 2) Ask customer to revert recent egress change or confirm their firewall allows control-plane IPs. 3) If fallback restores heartbeats, keep monitoring and schedule a coordinated rollback window.

ben: applied fallback route at 06:14:12Z. Agent heartbeats resumed by 06:14:45Z — control plane reports agent back online. 

sara: confirmed with customer that deploys are now succeeding. Customer asked to keep the fallback for 1 hour while they audit.

marta: updating incident doc and runbook: created timeline, root-cause suspected as customer-side routing change; now in mitigation. Next steps: vendor case (ben), customer postmortem sync, and longer-term guardrails for peer route changes.

aj: perf/ops handoff: I'll stay on until 06:30Z, then hand to backup if still stable. Notifying status page team to post a brief update. 

incident-bot: Incident PD-9876 status changed to "mitigated" (partial) at 2026-03-14T06:15:40Z.

sara: leaving note for postmortem: include packet captures from cp-host-3 and logs from agent between 06:10-06:16. I'll schedule a 30-min RCA in the morning with customer and network. :white_check_mark:
